children.label: Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) data with Satpy

children.value: Using Satpy to read and  Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) data from GOES-R satellites. Here’s a step-by-step guide:

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
warnings.simplefilter('ignore', SyntaxWarning)

from satpy.scene import Scene
from satpy.utils import debug_on

from datetime import datetime

from glob import glob

scn = Scene(filenames = sat_files, reader='abi_l1b')

dataset_names = scn.all_dataset_names()

print(dataset_names)
